question: If the exact Simulator-internal shared latent line-state component omitted from frozen C1 is supplied only to a diagnostic C1_ORACLE control, does fixed N1's W1 Synthetic expected-log-loss advantage over frozen C1 disappear or materially shrink?
scientific_success_rule: No model ranking is required. Falsifying LATENT_SHARED_PROXY_DOMINANT is a successful scientific outcome.

fixed_models.C1: Frozen C1 exactly as defined by KEIRIN_FROZEN_PRE_HOLDOUT_COEFFICIENT_RECEIPT_v1
fixed_models.N1: Frozen N1 exactly as defined by KEIRIN_FROZEN_PRE_HOLDOUT_COEFFICIENT_RECEIPT_v1

C1_ORACLE.only_added_information: For each rider, add exactly 0.16 times the mean latent_skill of riders sharing that rider's synthetic line_id, matching the canonical W1 shared-latent utility component.
C1_ORACLE.generator: The same exact Plackett-Luce ordered-top3 generator as C1
C1_ORACLE.oracle_coefficient_source: Canonical digital_twin_v1 W1 truth construction, not fitted from results

oracle_information_sufficiency_contract.runtime_check: For every rider in every case, independently reconstruct the canonical W1 shared-latent component as canonical_W1_static_utility minus canonical_W0_base_utility minus canonical position bonus minus canonical size bonus and require max absolute difference <= 1e-12.

primary_metric: Mean exact expected ordered-top3 log loss under canonical W1 truth; lower is better.

primary_effect.residual_advantage_ratio_definition: If N1_minus_C1_ORACLE < 0, residual_ratio = abs(N1_minus_C1_ORACLE) / abs(prior N1_minus_C1 baseline); otherwise residual_ratio = 0 because N1 advantage has disappeared or reversed.

secondary_diagnostics_prespecified.chain_rule_decomposition: Decompose C1, N1 and C1_ORACLE cross-entropy into rank1, rank2|rank1 and rank3|rank1,rank2 terms. This is exhaustive and additive, not subgroup slicing.
secondary_diagnostics_prespecified.block_stability: Report the same effect for each of the four already-fixed seed blocks. Do not add blocks after seeing results.
secondary_diagnostics_prespecified.oracle_improvement_over_C1: Report C1_ORACLE_minus_C1 to verify the oracle information has measurable W1 utility under this fixed simulator.

mechanical_pass_criteria: canonical W1 truth probability mass valid
C1/N1/C1_ORACLE probability objects valid and unit mass
frozen C1 and N1 coefficients unchanged
C1 and N1 non-oracle predictions exactly match existing harness outputs within 1e-12
oracle shared-state component matches canonical W1 truth component within 1e-12
prior W1 N1-minus-C1 aggregate reproduced within 1e-12
scientific Segment C scoring count remains 0
forbidden: treating C1_ORACLE as a formal model candidate
post_result_rule: Record the result regardless of direction. Do not retune, add conditions, add seeds, promote a model, or auto-expand authorization after the result.
